schemes.title: Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana (Sehat Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency Punjab, Department of Health & Family Welfare
schemes.brief: A free health cover of Rs 10 lakh a year for every family living in Punjab, with no income limit. Treatment is cashless at government and listed private hospitals: you show the Sehat Card and the hospital bills the government. It replaced the older Ayushman Bharat Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana, which gave Rs 5 lakh only to listed families. You register the family once at a CSC with Aadhaar and Voter ID.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10 lakh a year per family, cashless, at 900+ hospitals
eligibility: Every family living in Punjab, rich or poor. There is no income limit
Government employees and pensioners are covered too
Each adult member needs an Aadhaar card and a Voter ID card with a Punjab address. Aadhaar e-KYC is compulsory
Covers more than 2,000 treatments, including costs before and after admission, at government and listed private hospitals
A person living alone can enrol as a one-member family with a declaration verified by the Sarpanch, Municipal Councillor or MLA
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member, for e-KYC
Voter ID card of every adult member
A mobile number, for the SMS that confirms registration
Family Declaration Form (for families new to the scheme), signed by the head, with a copy of the head's Voter ID pasted on it
Single Member Declaration Form with photo, if you live alone, verified by the Sarpanch, Municipal Councillor or MLA
schemes.submitAt: Your nearest CSC (Common Service Centre). Take every member's Aadhaar card, every adult's Voter ID, a mobile number and, if your family is new to the scheme, the filled Family Declaration Form (or the Single Member form if you live alone). Registration and the card are free. The Sehat Card is handed out at the same CSC in 2 to 3 weeks.

demoFields.hint: The head of the family, written exactly as on his or her Voter ID card.

demoFields.label: S/o, D/o or W/o
demoFields.hint: Father's name, or husband's name for a married woman.

demoFields.label: House No.
demoFields.hint: House number where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Village/Town
demoFields.hint: Your village or town in Punjab.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district of that village or town.

demoFields.label: Member 1: Name / Relation / Age
demoFields.hint: Start with yourself, then add every member who lives with you. The form has room for 8 members.

demoFields.label: Member 2: Name / Relation / Age
demoFields.hint: Relation is how this person is related to you, the declarant.

demoFields.label: Voter ID no. (last column)
demoFields.hint: Write each adult's Voter ID number. Children have none: leave it blank and carry their Aadhaar cards.

demoFields.hint: Paste only your Voter ID copy here. The form says not to attach any other document.

demoFields.label: Dated / Place / Signature
demoFields.hint: Sign only after checking every name. A false entry can cancel the family's cover.

demoSteps: Check whether your family is already listed: open sha.punjab.gov.in, choose Check for Eligibility and search with your Aadhaar.
If the family is new, download the Family Declaration Form from the Resources menu on sha.punjab.gov.in, fill in every member and paste the head's Voter ID copy.
Go to the nearest CSC with all members' Aadhaar cards and the adults' Voter IDs. The operator does Aadhaar e-KYC for each member by fingerprint or OTP.
An SMS confirming the registration and your benefits comes at once. Keep this message.
The printed Sehat Card is given at the same CSC within 2 to 3 weeks. You can also download it from Download Health Card on sha.punjab.gov.in.
At any listed government or private hospital, show the Sehat Card at the help desk. The hospital checks your details digitally and treats you cashless up to Rs 10 lakh a year.
schemes.helpline: 104 (Sehat Card, hospital and grievance helpline, State Health Agency Punjab)

schemes.title: Ashirwad Scheme (Shagun for Daughter's Marriage)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment & Minorities, Punjab
schemes.brief: Rs 51,000 from the Punjab government for the marriage of a daughter from a poor Scheduled Caste, Christian, Backward Class or economically weaker family, or the daughter of a widow of any caste. It was earlier called the Shagun scheme. Since 28 January 2026 applications are taken only at Sewa Kendras, before the wedding or within 60 days after it, and the money goes straight to the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs 51,000 per daughter, for up to two daughters
eligibility: Daughters of Scheduled Caste, Christian, Backward Class and economically weaker families, and daughters of widows of any caste. Scheduled Caste widows and divorced women also get it when they remarry
Family income from all sources must not be more than Rs 32,790 a year
The girl must be at least 18 years old on the wedding day
Her parents or guardian must be permanent residents of Punjab
Apply before the wedding date or within 60 days after it
At most two daughters of one family can get the money
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant (parent or guardian) and of the bride
Caste certificate (SC or BC) and proof of address in Punjab
Proof of the girl's age: birth certificate or school certificate
Self-declaration of family income
Bank passbook of the applicant, showing account number and IFSC
Wedding card, and the marriage certificate from the gurdwara, temple, church or other religious place
Family BPL or blue ration card, if you have one
Photos of the applicant, the bride and the groom
schemes.submitAt: Any Sewa Kendra in Punjab. Take a token at the counter, or book a slot first on connect.punjab.gov.in. Since 28 January 2026 Ashirwad applications are accepted only at Sewa Kendras, so do not pay anyone to apply elsewhere. Take the originals and copies of all documents and the photos. There is no fee.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: The mother, father or guardian who is applying, as written on Aadhaar. For a widow's daughter, the mother applies.

demoFields.label: Relation with the bride
demoFields.hint: How the applicant is related to the girl getting married.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the applicant's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: SC, Christian, BC, economically weaker, or daughter of a widow. It decides which certificate is checked.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Everyone's earnings in the family for a full year. Above Rs 32,790 the file is rejected.

demoFields.label: Bride's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must match her birth or school certificate. She must be 18 or older on the wedding day.

demoFields.label: Date of marriage
demoFields.hint: Apply before this date or within 60 days after it. Later applications are not taken.

demoFields.label: Groom's name and address
demoFields.value: Jaspreet Singh, Village Bhaini Kalan, Ludhiana
demoFields.hint: As printed on the wedding card.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the applicant's own name, linked to Aadhaar. The Rs 51,000 is sent here.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Updates on the application and the payment SMS come to this number.

demoSteps: Collect all the documents and photos. Get the caste certificate and the income self-declaration ready before the wedding.
Go to the nearest Sewa Kendra, take a token and ask for the Ashirwad Scheme. The operator fills in the application and scans your documents.
Keep the receipt with the application number. Track it on connect.punjab.gov.in under Track, or by calling 1100.
The Tehsil and District Welfare Officers check the papers, and the district committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner approves it. The service time is about 47 days.
After sanction, Rs 51,000 is sent by DBT straight into the applicant's bank account, and an SMS comes when it is credited.
schemes.helpline: 1100 (Punjab Sewa Kendra and Connect helpline) / District and Tehsil Welfare Officer (list under Contact Details on ashirwad.punjab.gov.in)

schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme (Budhapa Pension)
schemes.department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.brief: A pension of Rs 1,500 every month for women aged 58 and above and men aged 65 and above in Punjab whose income is low. The money is paid into the pensioner's bank account. You can apply online on Connect Punjab, at any Sewa Kendra, or by calling 1076 for an operator to come home. There is no fee and no paper form.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 a month, paid into your bank account
eligibility: Women aged 58 or above, men aged 65 or above
Total yearly income not more than Rs 60,000, counting business, rent and interest
Husband and wife together may own up to 2.5 acres of canal or well-irrigated (nehri/chahi) land, or up to 5 acres of barani or waterlogged land
You must be a resident of Punjab
The CDPO verifies the case within a month and the District Social Security Officer sanctions it
documents: Aadhaar card (proof of identity, address and age)
A second proof of age: voter card or voter list entry, birth certificate or matriculation certificate
First page of the bank passbook
Self-declaration
Village: land report from the Patwari. City: property verification from the Executive Officer of the Municipal Council
Mobile number, for OTP and SMS updates

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: The elderly person who will get the pension, as written on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: As written on your Aadhaar or voter card.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Women can apply from 58, men from 65.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must match the Aadhaar and your second age proof, such as the voter list or matric certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar e-KYC is done for this service, so give the pensioner's own number.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: OTP and messages about the pension come here. A son's or daughter's number is fine.

demoFields.label: Address (village, tehsil, district)
demoFields.value: Village Rampura Kalan, Tehsil Malout, Sri Muktsar Sahib
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. The CDPO of this area verifies the case.

demoFields.label: Annual income from all sources
demoFields.hint: Include rent, business and bank interest. The limit is Rs 60,000 a year.

demoFields.label: Land owned (husband and wife)
demoFields.hint: Up to 2.5 acres nehri/chahi or 5 acres barani is allowed. The Patwari's report must say the same.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The pensioner's own account. Upload the first page of this passbook.

demoSteps: Open connect.punjab.gov.in, find Old Age Pension Scheme in the services list and tap Click to apply service. If you cannot go online, call 1076 and an operator will come home, or visit a Sewa Kendra.
Log in or register with your mobile number and OTP, and complete Aadhaar e-KYC for the person applying.
Fill in the form, upload the age proof, passbook page, self-declaration and the land or property report, and submit. There is no fee.
Note the application number on the receipt and follow it under Track on Connect Punjab.
The CDPO verifies your details and the District Social Security Officer sanctions the pension. The service time is 32 days online and 34 days at a Sewa Kendra.
After sanction, Rs 1,500 a month is credited to your bank account. For problems, contact the District Social Security Officer.
schemes.helpline: 1100 (Connect Punjab and Sewa Kendra helpline) / 1076 (doorstep service) / 0172-2608746 (Social Security head office) / 14567 (elderly helpline)

schemes.title: Deen Dayal Lado Lakshmi Yojana (Lado Lakshmi)
schemes.department: SEWA Department (Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs and Antyodaya), Haryana
schemes.brief: Rs 2,100 a month for women aged 23 and above from the poorest families of Haryana. From the second month, Rs 1,100 comes to your savings account and Rs 1,000 is saved for you in a government recurring deposit, paid back with interest when it matures (within five years). You apply only on the official Lado Lakshmi mobile app using your Family ID (PPP). There is no paper form, and any other link or form is fake.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,100 a month (Rs 1,100 in hand + Rs 1,000 saved in a government RD)
eligibility: Woman aged 23 or above. Any number of eligible women in one family can apply
Family income verified in the Family ID (PPP) not more than Rs 1 lakh a year, and the family endorsed as poorest of the poor by the Gram Sabha or Ward Committee

Or family income up to Rs 1.80 lakh if a child in a government school scored over 80% in Class 10 or 12, reached the NIPUN grade level in Classes 1 to 4, or was brought out of malnutrition (SAM/MAM). Mothers of more than three children cannot use this route
She, or her husband if she married into Haryana from another state, has lived in Haryana for at least 15 years
Not for women already getting the old age, widow, Divyang or Ladli allowance or any other government pension, government employees whose family income is above the limit, or income tax payers
documents: Family ID (Parivar Pehchan Patra) with verified income
Aadhaar card of the applicant, and Aadhaar details of family members
Haryana residence certificate (15 years)
Savings bank account in the woman's own name
Electricity connection (consumer account) number
Vehicle ownership details and HKRN ID, if any
A smartphone, with the mobile number for OTP and the monthly face check

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Type your number in the app and enter the OTP. The eligibility and payment SMS come here.

demoFields.label: Family ID (PPP)
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit Family ID. Your income and family details are taken from it.

demoFields.label: Select applicant
demoFields.hint: The app shows the members on the Family ID. Pick the woman who is applying. She must be 23 or older.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's own Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Residence in Haryana
demoFields.hint: If you married into Haryana from another state, your husband's 15 years of residence counts.

demoFields.label: Electricity consumer account number
demoFields.hint: Printed on your electricity bill.

demoFields.label: Vehicle owned
demoFields.hint: Give any car or other vehicle owned by the family. It is checked against transport records.

demoFields.label: HKRN ID
demoFields.hint: Only if you or a family member work through Haryana Kaushal Rozgar Nigam.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Must be in the woman's own name. PFMS checks it before the first payment.

demoFields.label: Monthly amount you choose
demoFields.hint: Asked by SMS after verification. If you choose Rs 1,500 or less, Rs 500 is paid and Rs 1,000 still goes into the RD.

demoSteps: Install the Lado Lakshmi app (made by HARTRON for the Haryana government) from Google Play or the App Store. Do not use any other app, link or form.
Register with your mobile number and OTP, choose Apply for the Scheme, enter the Family ID and pick the woman who is applying.
Fill in the Aadhaar, residence, electricity, vehicle and bank details and submit. Note the Registration ID shown on screen.
CRID checks your details against Family ID records within 15 days. If you are eligible, an SMS asks you to choose the monthly amount: confirm it and give consent in the app with your Registration ID.

The District Social Welfare Officer creates your DDLLY ID and PFMS checks the bank account. Payment starts the next month: Rs 2,100 in full the first month, then Rs 1,100 to the account and Rs 1,000 to the RD.
After the first payment, do the face check (Blink to Click) in the app every month, or the money stops. Raise any complaint in the app's grievance window: the DSWO must act within 7 days.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-2231 (toll-free Lado Lakshmi helpline) / 0172-4880500 (Family ID and verification helpline)

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat Chirayu Haryana (Chirayu Card)
schemes.department: Ayushman Bharat Haryana Health Protection Authority, Health Department, Haryana
schemes.brief: Haryana's extension of Ayushman Bharat: Rs 5 lakh a year of cashless hospital treatment for the whole family. Families whose income in the Family ID (PPP) is up to Rs 1.80 lakh are covered free. Families above that can join by paying a yearly fee online: Rs 1,500 for income up to Rs 3 lakh, Rs 4,000 up to Rs 6 lakh and Rs 5,000 above Rs 6 lakh. For the cover year 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027, the fee portal is open until 30 November 2026.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless; free up to Rs 1.80 lakh income
eligibility: Families living in Haryana with a Family ID (PPP). Eligibility and the fee go by the verified income in the PPP
Verified income up to Rs 1.80 lakh a year: covered free
Above Rs 1.80 lakh up to Rs 3 lakh: Rs 1,500 a year per family
Above Rs 3 lakh up to Rs 6 lakh: Rs 4,000 a year. Above Rs 6 lakh: Rs 5,000 a year
No limit on family size or age. Every member on the Family ID is covered
documents: Family ID (PPP) number, with income verified
Mobile number registered in the Family ID, for the OTP
Aadhaar card of each member, for the card e-KYC
UPI, debit card or net banking to pay the fee, or cash at a CSC
Payment receipt or reference number, as proof that you paid

demoFields.label: Your PPP ID / Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Choose whether to search by Family ID or Aadhaar. If you have forgotten the Family ID, use I forgot my PPP ID and search with Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: PPP ID
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit Family ID of your family.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Sent to the mobile number registered in the Family ID, not any other number.

demoFields.label: Terms and conditions
demoFields.hint: Read the fee table and the dates, tick the box and continue.

demoFields.label: Linked Member Info
demoFields.hint: Check that every member is listed. A missing member must first be added in the Family ID.

demoFields.label: Family Head Name
demoFields.hint: Shown after Check Eligibility, with your verified income band.

demoFields.label: Amount to be paid
demoFields.hint: Set by the verified income: Rs 1,500, Rs 4,000 or Rs 5,000 a year.

demoFields.label: Payment partner
demoFields.hint: Choose Canara Bank to pay yourself, or CSC (Digital Seva Connect) if a CSC operator is paying for you.

demoFields.label: Payment mode
demoFields.hint: UPI and RuPay debit cards have no extra charge. Other cards may add a small bank fee.

demoFields.label: Reference number
demoFields.hint: Save it. Use Check Payment Status on the home page to see the payment and download the receipt.

demoSteps: If your Family ID income is up to Rs 1.80 lakh you pay nothing: get the Ayushman (Chirayu) card made at a CSC, Saral Kendra or empanelled hospital, or yourself on beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar e-KYC.
If your income is above Rs 1.80 lakh, open chirayuayushmanharyana.in before 30 November 2026 and tap the apply button.
Accept the terms, enter the Family ID (or Aadhaar) and the OTP sent to the registered mobile, then check the members and the eligibility shown.
Pay the fee shown (Rs 1,500, Rs 4,000 or Rs 5,000) through Canara Bank by UPI, card or net banking, or at a CSC, and download the receipt.
Your cover runs from 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027. Get each member's card made with Aadhaar e-KYC on beneficiary.nha.gov.in, the Ayushman app or at a CSC.
At an empanelled hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card. Treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year is cashless, so do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-2036 (Ayushman Bharat Haryana toll-free) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)

schemes.title: Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID / PPP)
schemes.department: Haryana Parivar Pehchan Authority, Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID), Haryana
schemes.brief: An 8-digit Family ID for every family living in Haryana, holding each member's details, income and bank account in one record. Almost every Haryana scheme uses it, from pensions and ration cards to Chirayu health cover and Lado Lakshmi, so once it is verified you need not prove the same things again. Making or updating it is free. You can create it yourself online, or get it made at a CSC, Saral Kendra or PPP operator.
schemes.benefit: Free Family ID that opens Haryana schemes and selects you for benefits automatically
eligibility: Every family living in Haryana should enrol. It gets a permanent 8-digit Family ID
A family living outside Haryana that needs a Haryana service gets a 9-digit temporary ID starting with T
Creating, updating and downloading the Family ID are free, even at an operator. Never pay a fee
Income, caste and other details are verified by the department. Verified details cannot be edited later
Births, deaths and marriages are linked to it, so the record updates itself
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member
Mobile number of the head of family, for OTP
Bank passbook of the head of family and earning members
Income details of every earning member (salary, farming, business)
Caste certificate, if you belong to SC, BC or another category
Disability certificate, if any member is Divyang

demoFields.label: Do you Know Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)?
demoFields.hint: Choose NO to make a new Family ID. Choose YES if your family already has one and you want to see or update it.

demoFields.label: Search With Aadhar No.
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head of family. The system first checks whether you are already in some Family ID.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Sent to the mobile number linked with that Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Head of family: name, date of birth, gender
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: This number gets every OTP for the Family ID later, so give one you will keep.

demoFields.label: Address (district, block or town, village or ward, house no.)
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Caste category
demoFields.hint: Choose General, SC, BC-A or BC-B. It is checked against your caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual income of each member
demoFields.hint: Give true income. Schemes like Chirayu and Lado Lakshmi use the verified family income.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC (head of family)
demoFields.hint: Pensions and other scheme money are sent to the account recorded here.

demoFields.label: Family members (name, relation, Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Add everyone who lives and eats together. Married daughters go to their husband's Family ID.

demoSteps: Open meraparivar.haryana.gov.in and choose I want to create my PPP, or open the PPP citizen login page and answer NO.
Search with the head of family's Aadhaar and verify the OTP. Then fill in the head's details, address, caste, income and bank account, and add each member with Aadhaar.
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. If the portal asks, download the filled PPP form, have the head of family sign it and upload it. After this, only one change is allowed.
The department verifies income and other details through records and field checks. Checked details are marked Verified.
The 8-digit Family ID comes by SMS. Download it any time on meraparivar.haryana.gov.in with the Family ID and an OTP.
If you cannot do it yourself, a CSC, Antyodaya Saral Kendra or PPP operator does it free. For wrong income or caste, use the correction module or Report Grievance on the PPP site.
schemes.helpline: 0172-4880500 (Family ID helpline, 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday) / 98886 33322 (PPP helpline)
